title: Glocalizing Generative AI in Education for the Global South: The Design Case of 21st Century Teacher Educator AI for Ghana

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through pilot implementation and stakeholder feedback (pre-service teachers and educators) assessing the alignment of generated content with Ghanaian cultural values, local examples, and the National Teacher Education Curriculum Framework.

Observation of model performance and hallucinations during pilot testing when processing and translating educational content into indigenous Ghanaian languages (e.g., Twi, Dagbani, Mampruli, Dagaare) compared to English.

Design case analysis using the 'Mitigating GenAI Neocolonialism' framework to evaluate the extent to which the tool centers Global South epistemologies and reduces reliance on dominant Western data hierarchies.
